question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A government ruled by a king or queen.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Monarchy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Monarchy"** refers to a form of government in which a king or queen rules the state or country. (राजशाही)
 
 
• **Example:** The United Kingdom is an example of a constitutional monarchy where the monarch shares power with an elected parliament.
 
 
• **"Monarchy"** typically involves hereditary succession, where the throne is passed down through a royal family. (राजशाही)
 
 
• **Example:** The monarchy of Japan is one of the oldest hereditary monarchies in the world.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Monarchy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Autocracy** (स्वतंत्र तानाशाही): A system of government where one person has unlimited power over the state.
 
 
• **Example:** North Korea is often considered an autocracy because the leader has absolute control over the government.
 
 
 
• **Democracy** (लोकतंत्र): A system of government where the citizens vote to elect their leaders or representatives.
 
 
• **Example:** India is the largest democracy in the world.
 
 
 
• **Dictatorship** (तानाशाही): A form of government where a single leader or group has absolute power, often taken by force.
 
 
• **Example:** Adolf Hitler's rule in Nazi Germany is a historical example of dictatorship.
